newsitem.title: USA: Clinton picks Joel Klein for antitrust post.
newsitem.headline: Clinton picks Joel Klein for antitrust post.

text.p: President Clinton announced Friday he will nominate Joel Klein to head the Justice Department's antitrust division.

"Joel Klein is an outstanding attorney and dedicated public servant," Clinton said in a statement. "He has served me well over the past three years and I am confident that he will continue to do a superb job in the antitrust division."
